newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EVN says seeks to close Bewag deal.
newsitem.headline: EVN says seeks to close Bewag deal.

text.p: Austrian regional utility Energie-Versorgung Niederoesterreich AG (EVN) said on Tuesday it was seeking to close a long-sought cooperation deal with south-east Austrian gas supplier Bewag.

"We want to cooperate but we do not seek a stake in Bewag", EVN chief executive Rudolf Gruber told a news briefing, adding the group was also searching for other provincial utilities to cooperate with.
EVN and OMV, the oil and chemicals group and Austria's biggest industrial group, have for more than a year been in a row over a 25 percent stake in Bewag.
EVN already controls indirectly about 48 percent of Bewag's capital via Burgenland Holding AG. EVN has built up its majority in Burgenland Holding over the past twelve months.
"We have submitted a comprehensive offer and hope we will be able to continue our fruitful cooperation", Gruber said.
Bewag favours OMV as a strategic partner. The group also enjoys the support of the 73 communities which control the majority of Bewag. -- Christian Gutlederer, Vienna newsroom, +431 53112-275
